citation.authors: Rahat-Rozenbloom S, Fernandes J, Cheng J, Wolever TMS
citation.title: The acute effects of inulin and resistant-starch on postprandial serum short-chain fatty acids and second-meal glycaemic response in lean and overweight humans

population.description: 25 non-diabetic adults (12 lean, BMI<25; 13 overweight/obese, BMI>=25), 12 men and 13 women, enrolled aged 18-65 with BMI at least 20 and at most 35 kg/m2 (printed garbled as '353kg/m2', read as 35); excluded for diabetes, cardiovascular, bowel, kidney or liver disease, glucose-affecting drugs, smoking, fasting glucose >=7.0 mmol/L. No glucose tolerance test was reported, so 'unselected'. Age and BMI SD computed as SEM x sqrt(25) from Table 1 (age 39.8 +/- 2.8 gives 14.0; BMI 27.5 +/- 1.0 gives 5.0).

protocols.name: glucose_drink
protocols.description: Control: 75 g glucose in 300 mL water (Test drinks). Drink within 5 min after the fasting blood sample, 300 mL water; blood at 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4 h (standard lunch at 4 h is not entered: its grams are in the supplementary information, not in the paper). Arrived 08:00 after a 12 h fast; the drink time is not printed, so 08:00 is assumed for start_hour.

protocols.name: inulin_drink
protocols.description: 75 g glucose plus 24 g inulin in 300 mL water (Test drinks). carbs_g 75 as printed. The paper writes 75 g glucose + 24 g inulin product (90% dietary fibre, 10% free fructose, glucose and saccharose), so by the label the fibre is 24 x 0.9 = 21.6 g and the free sugars 2.4 g; neither is printed in grams. fibre_g 24 follows the authors' own statement that the RS dose was chosen so its fibre 'equaled the dose of inulin' (24 g), and the 2.4 g of free sugars is not added to carbs_g. Drink within 5 min after the fasting blood sample, 300 mL water; blood at 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4 h (standard lunch at 4 h is not entered: its grams are in the supplementary information, not in the paper). Arrived 08:00 after a 12 h fast; the drink time is not printed, so 08:00 is assumed for start_hour.

meals.food: 75 g glucose and 24 g inulin in 300 mL water

protocols.name: rs_drink
protocols.description: 75 g glucose plus 28 g Nutriose resistant starch in 300 mL water (Test drinks: 'total fibre content of 85%; 24g RS and 4.2g rapidly digestible starch'). Derived: carbs_g = 75 + 4.2 = 79.2 (the 4.2 g rapidly digestible starch counted as available carbohydrate); fibre_g 24 as printed ('24g RS'; also the dose 'equaled the dose of inulin'). Drink within 5 min after the fasting blood sample, 300 mL water; blood at 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4 h (standard lunch at 4 h is not entered: its grams are in the supplementary information, not in the paper). Arrived 08:00 after a 12 h fast; the drink time is not printed, so 08:00 is assumed for start_hour.

meals.food: 75 g glucose and 28 g Nutriose resistant starch in 300 mL water

left_out.what: glucose, insulin and FFA tAUC 4-6 h after the standard lunch (Table 3): the lunch (cheese and tomato sandwich, apple juice 200 mL, water, two chocolate cookies) is given without grams in the paper, only in the supplementary information
C-peptide iAUC 0-2 h, iAUC 2-4 h, tAUC 4-6 h per drink (Table 3) and by BMI group (Table 4)
FFA iAUC from the nadir to 4 h (iAUCmin4) per drink (Table 3): baseline is each person's own minimum over the first 4 h, not the fasting sample or a fixed window
serum acetate per drink: tAUC 0-4 h, tAUC 4-6 h, iAUC nadir-6 h (Table 2), fasting acetate (Table 1)
serum propionate and butyrate per drink (Table 2) and fasting values (Table 1)
breath hydrogen and methane (Results, Supplementary Figure 3)

lean against overweight/obese comparison of glucose, insulin, FFA, C-peptide and SCFA areas (Table 4): each number is the mean over a participant's three visits, i.e. over the glucose, inulin and RS drinks together, which is no single protocol
fasting glucose of the whole group (Table 1, 4.87 with a printed SEM of 0.84, against SEMs of 0.12 and 0.11 in its two subgroups): the SEM looks misprinted
time courses of glucose, insulin, C-peptide, FFA, SCFA (Figures 1 and 2)
fasting total, HDL and LDL cholesterol (Table 1)
inulin and resistant starch against glucose differences in glucose, insulin and FFA areas: the arms differ only in added fibre, which the model does not read yet
